title: Review verdict
description: Output of the reviewer role. The verdict is a recommendation to the human who merges; the reviewer never approves or merges on GitHub.

verdict.description: approve only if every criterion is met and no comment is a blocker or major.

summary.description: The review in a few sentences.

path.description: File the comment is about, relative to the repo root, or null for a general comment.

line.description: Line in the new version of the file, or null for the whole file or a general comment.

severity.description: blocker: must not merge (bug, security, data loss); major: must fix; minor: should fix; nit: optional.

body.description: What is wrong and what to do instead.

criteria_check.description: One entry per acceptance criterion of the task.

evidence.description: The code and test that show it, or what is missing.
